_readme: 三处 UI（桥 APK / 控制台 APK / 页面插件 dsh-mobile-local）的唯一文案源。
改这里 → 跑 tools/ui-controls gen → 三个产物同步；tools/ui-controls check 进自检。
产物：plugins/dsh-mobile-local/client.js 内的 generated:controls 块、
~/dsh-console/src/io/dsh/console/UiControls.java、~/droid-bridge/src/io/dsh/bridge/UiControls.java（再由 sync-apps.sh 镜像进仓库 apps/）。
kind: button=点一次触发一次动作 · switch=持续状态 · lamp=只读状态灯 · text=只读文本。
危险标记**不改变分类**：只在所属分类里加红边框 + ⚠ 图标（用户 2026-09-27 明确要求）。
术语不翻译：adb / token / GitHub / Wi-Fi / DSH / APK / SHA256 / exit 保持原样。

groups.en: adb · wireless debugging, needs working Wi-Fi
groups.zh: adb · 无线调试，需要可用 Wi-Fi
桥 · 无障碍回环，不需要网络

groups.en: Danger zone · only you can undo it by hand
groups.zh: 危险操作 · 只能你手动恢复

hint.en: On = DSH may drive the phone through this app (listening on 127.0.0.1:8788). Off = soft stop: the port closes, the process stays, and one broadcast brings it back.
hint.zh: 开 = 允许 DSH 通过本 App 操作手机（监听 127.0.0.1:8788）。关 = 软停：端口关闭、进程保留，一条广播就能拉回。

hint.en: Four states from one ping plus the state note (no timers): running / just dropped (wakeable, one broadcast brings it back) / long silent (the process went away on its own or is bound but not answering - waking may work, otherwise open DSH Bridge once) / not installed (this install has never been seen alive here).
hint.zh: 四态由**一次 ping 的结果 + 状态记录**判定（不看时间）：运行中 / 刚断（可唤醒，一条广播就能拉回）/ 长时间未响应（进程自己没了，或端口在听却不应答 —— 唤醒可能有效，无效就手动打开一次「DSH 桥」）/ 未安装（这台机器上从没见过它是活的）。

hint.en: Sends one token-carrying broadcast. Never takes your screen. Can take 20-40s if the process was reclaimed.
hint.zh: 发一条带 token 的广播把它唤回，绝不抢你的屏幕。进程被回收时要 20-40 秒。

hint.en: Read-only: is the port listening, does it really answer, version, paused flag.
hint.zh: 只读：端口是否在听、是否真应答、版本、是否被暂停。

hint.en: adb first, then the bridge. Use only when you need both; a failure names the channel it came from.
hint.zh: 先 adb 后桥。两条都要时才用；失败会说清是哪条通道。

hint.en: Starts DSH and opens the page; if it is already running it only opens the page.
hint.zh: 启动 DSH 并打开页面；已在运行则只打开页面。

hint.en: Restarts the service with SIGTERM. Cost: drops the current web session.
hint.zh: 用 SIGTERM 重启服务。代价：会断开当前网页会话。

hint.en: Restarts after a kill -9 and clears the orphan lock. Cost: drops the current web session.
hint.zh: 强杀后重启并清孤儿锁。代价：会断开当前网页会话。

hint.en: Stops DSH and closes the browser. The bridge is a separate channel and is left alone by default.
hint.zh: 关闭 DSH 并关浏览器。桥是另一条通道，默认不动它。

hint.en: Wi-Fi state → Wireless debugging switch (written through the bridge) → port → connect → verify. Says which step failed.
hint.zh: Wi-Fi 状态 → 无线调试开关（这一步借桥来写）→ 端口 → 连接 → 复核。卡在哪一步就说哪一步。

hint.en: Wireless debugging only. Needs a real Wi-Fi network, not just the switch.
hint.zh: 只走无线调试。需要有真实可用的 Wi-Fi，不只是拨开关。

hint.en: Lets the App exit and unbinds accessibility. On this vivo it may not be wakeable again - you would have to open DSH Bridge by hand.
hint.zh: 让 App 退出并解绑无障碍。这台 vivo 上可能唤不回来 —— 只能你手动打开「DSH 桥」。

hint.en: Green = usable, yellow = connecting, red = failed, grey = not connected (check Wi-Fi).
hint.zh: 绿=可用，黄=连接中，红=失败，灰=未连接（看 Wi-Fi）。

hint.en: When foreign sites die: decides whether the Clash core stopped or the config went bad, then repairs.
hint.zh: 外网全挂时用：先判 Clash 核心停了还是配置坏了，再修。

hint.en: Downloads the two APKs from GitHub Releases, verifies SHA256, then installs them.
hint.zh: 从 GitHub Releases 下载两个 APK，校验 SHA256 后安装。

hint.en: Packs DSH state and verifies the archive; the result goes to Download/dsh/.
hint.zh: 打包 DSH 状态并校验归档；产物落 Download/dsh/。

hint.en: Deletes only this kit's own artifacts. Your files are not touched.
hint.zh: 只删本工具自己的产物，不碰你的文件。

hint.en: System / Chinese / English. The widgets and the page panel follow this too.
hint.zh: 跟随系统 / 中文 / English。小组件和页面面板也跟着变。

hint.en: Opens github.com/Maopk/dsh-termux-kit - source, releases and docs.
hint.zh: 打开 github.com/Maopk/dsh-termux-kit —— 源码、发行版和文档。

hint.en: Installed version and whether a newer release exists. If the check fails it says so instead of claiming it is up to date.
hint.zh: 已装版本 + 有没有新发行版。查不到就直说查不到，不谎报「已是最新」。

hint.en: Copies the bridge token, which the Termux side needs. Handing it out is handing out the key to this channel.
hint.zh: 复制桥的 token（Termux 侧要用）。把它交出去等于交出这条通道的钥匙。

hint.en: For the first setup, or after the system unbound the service and it has to be re-enabled by hand.
hint.zh: 首次启用，或被系统解绑后需要手动重新打开时用。

hint.en: Re-reads the accessibility state from the system and starts listening again if it was soft-stopped.
hint.zh: 从系统重新读无障碍状态；被软停时用它恢复监听。

hint.en: Keeps the notification-bar emergency stop working; with notifications off you lose that rescue path.
hint.zh: 让通知栏的紧急停止可用；关掉通知就少一条自救路径。

hint.en: On = soft-stops itself after N idle minutes (less exposure, less battery). Off = always listening.
hint.zh: 开=闲置 N 分钟后自动软停（少暴露、省电）；关=一直监听。

hint.en: On = the AI may use your 6-digit lock-screen password to pass system verification for you (installing packages, removing settings restrictions). Off = revoked at once. It is never used to unlock the phone and read content, to pay, or for anything unrelated to the task at hand.
hint.zh: 开 = AI 可动用你的 6 位密码替你过系统验证（装包、解除应用设置限制）；关 = 立刻收回。绝不用于解锁手机翻看内容、支付/免密、或与当次任务无关的场景。

hint.en: Revokes the AI's control of the phone: soft-stops the bridge and revokes the token. adb is a separate channel and stays up.
hint.zh: 撤销 AI 对手机的控制：软停桥 + 吊销 token。adb 是另一条通道，不受影响。

hint.en: Turns accessibility off right now. The same button sits in the notification bar, which is why notifications must stay on.
hint.zh: 立刻关掉无障碍服务。通知栏里有一颗同样的按钮，所以别关通知。

hint.en: Green = the web service answers, yellow = half-started, red = down, grey = not running.
hint.zh: 绿=网页服务正常应答，黄=半启动，红=挂了，灰=没在跑。

hint.en: Green = listening and answering, grey = soft-stopped or not installed.
hint.zh: 绿=在听且真应答，灰=软停或未安装。

hint.en: Reads the state once and updates the lamps. Read-only: it never wakes a channel.
hint.zh: 只读读一次状态并更新状态灯，**不会唤醒任何通道**。

hint.en: History: scrollable, copyable. Results you tapped and automatic refreshes are kept apart and never overwrite each other.
hint.zh: 历史记录：可滚动、可复制。你点出来的和自动刷新的分开记，互不覆盖。
